Witness for the cachyos AUR route under the unified builder mechanism
(opencharly/sdk#608). It declares ONE tiny AUR package and nothing else, so
a build of any box composing it either routes that declaration to a builder
box and installs the package, or fails naming the candy.

The declaration is the whole point: `build:` lists OS package formats only,
and `aur` is deliberately absent from every `build:` list in this repo now.
The package reaches the image because this candy declares it under
`distro.arch.aur` and the box's builder map routes `aur` to
`arch.arch-builder` — inherited here from `base: cachyos`, which declares it.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | the AUR-installed yay is on PATH (the aur builder installs it via pacman, which puts it under /usr/sbin here) |
| `check` | yay runs and reports its version |
